title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
I am excited to come back to UBC! Everything felt familiar yet newer. There used to be a construction site near the bus loop and now it is turning into a new building.
I am gald that I could come back to chat with the professors I know and meet new people.
Last but not least, I am looking forward to become friends with all my classmates.
